gemini_description.purpose: Define general safety instructions, warning symbols, and regulatory compliance standards for installing, operating, and maintaining a pump system.
gemini_description.summary: This document details the critical safety indicators and operational regulations required to safely assemble, maintain, and operate pump systems. It highlights specific danger levels (such as electric shock, personal or property damage, and equipment damage) and establishes mandatory procedures like isolating electrical power before servicing and using only manufacturer-approved spare parts.

components.name: Electric Shock Danger Symbol (lightning bolt)
components.description: Indicates a severe hazard that could result in electric shock if safety instructions are ignored.

components.name: General Danger Symbol (exclamation mark in triangle)
components.description: Indicates hazards that could cause personal injury or property damage if instructions are not followed.

components.name: Equipment Warning Symbol (exclamation mark in square)
components.description: Indicates hazards that may result in physical damage to the pump or the installation setup.

components.name: Service/Plug Indicator Symbol
components.description: Identifies requirements for following the operational, installation, and service manual guidelines before power connection.

procedure: Read and thoroughly understand all installation and service instructions before starting assembly or maintenance.
Ensure all assembly, maintenance, and operation tasks are performed exclusively by authorized and qualified personnel.
Disconnect the pump and any connected auxiliary devices from the electrical power supply prior to executing any maintenance or physical handling.
Verify that all installed spare parts and accessories are approved by the original manufacturer to maintain system safety.
In the event of a malfunction, faulty operation, or breakdown, immediately contact the supplier or the nearest authorized distributor.

technical_details.detail: Electrical component hazard: Electrical parts of the pump are live during normal operation, requiring complete electrical isolation before any work is carried out.
Modification constraint: Any alteration to the pump requires prior written approval from the manufacturer to maintain safety levels and product warranty.
Spare parts policy: The manufacturer assumes no responsibility or liability for damages resulting from the use of unauthorized spare parts or accessories.

warnings.warning: Failure to comply with instructions associated with the electric shock symbol leads to direct risk of fatal electrical accidents.
Failure to follow guidelines marked by the general danger symbol can lead to personal injury or property damage.
Neglecting instructions marked by the exclamation warning symbol poses a significant risk of damaging the pump or the entire installation.
